title: Role Management CRUD Permission Consistency

items.action: update an organization role and its permissions

database.reason: No persistence model changes are introduced.

migration.reason: Existing Kyrox Core role permissions are reused.

backend.reason: Kyrox Core role-management authorization remains unchanged and authoritative.

tenant_isolation.reason: Existing organization scope enforcement remains unchanged.

audit.reason: Existing Kyrox Core role audit behavior remains unchanged.

route_guard.reason: This change hardens action callbacks; route access is unchanged.

notes: Organization role create, update, permission-update, and delete UI callbacks now fail closed using the same identity.roles.create/update/delete capabilities enforced by Kyrox Core. SuperAdmin-only template, sync, derive, and permission lifecycle flows are intentionally unchanged because Kyrox Core protects those endpoints with require_super_admin.
